notes.title: Meet the Four Starters of MonTamer and the Charming Town Liliance
notes.notes:
Hey MonTamers! 

Happy New Year to all of you! I've really missed our interactions. While I've been away from YouTube, I've been anything but idle. As the heart and soul behind MonTamer, I've poured my energy into creating something special for you all. And today, I'm super excited to share with you some of the magic I've been working on.

[previewyoutube=QD6-kNUXaT8;full][/previewyoutube]

🌟 Eight Months of Dedication:
It's been a long eight months since our last devlog, a journey filled with passion and creativity. Diving deep into the world of MonTamer, I've been busy designing and modeling an array of new monsters and the beautiful starting town. It's been a journey of creativity and hard work, and I'm buzzing with excitement for you to experience it all.

🏙️ Welcome to Liliance:
Let me introduce you to Liliance, the starting point of your MonTamer adventure. This isn't just your ordinary starting town; Liliance is a place of wonder and exploration, crafted to intrigue and invite you to uncover its secrets. The aesthetics and vibe of Liliance set the stage for an immersive journey unlike any other.

🐉 Your Starter Companions Await:
Now, let's talk about the stars of the show: our starter monsters! I've been pondering how much to reveal, as I want to keep the thrill of discovery alive. With over 103 monsters designed to date, our goal of 150 unique creatures is within reach. Meet your elemental companions:

Fyrox: The fiery heart, a blend of warmth and untamed power.
Aquaquack: Your water ally, echoing the might and flexibility of water.
Leafrog: A grass-type inspired by tree-frogs, symbolizing nature's adaptability.
Voltaroo: The electric spark of your team, embodying the raw force of electricity.
Which one captures your heart? The choice will shape your journey!

🌿 Interactivity and Evolutions:
What do you think about seeing their evolutions? I'm torn between keeping the mystery and sharing a glimpse. Your thoughts are super valuable! Plus, I've added interactive elements like sitting on chairs and swings, and even some fun mini-games for an extra splash of fun in MonTamer.

🚀 What's Next:
I'm committed to refining and enhancing the MonTamer experience, and your support has been my guiding star. Stay tuned for more updates and insights in future devlogs.

So, which starter has won you over? And should I tease their evolutions? Let me know in the comments!

Cheers to a year filled with adventure and discovery in MonTamer! Can't wait to share more with you soon.

Catch you in the next devlog!

notes.title: MonTamer Christmas Special
notes.notes:
[h1]Merry Christmas[/h1]

I wish everyone a Merry Christmas! To celebrate the feast I have published a small Christmas special on the YouTube channel. 
 
[previewyoutube=knyEZ-841bU;full][/previewyoutube]
 
[h2]Weather system[/h2]
The weather system in MonTamer will provide dynamic weather and make snow fall during winter time. There will also be rain in MonTamer. 

The different weather conditions will also have an effect on the world in MonTamer. Among other things, freezing lakes will make new areas accessible for exploration, and new Montams will appear that can only be found in snowy conditions. The same goes for Montams that only appear in the wilderness when it rains. 


We hope you like this little update and wish you a Merry Christmas.
